points.note: Small chain sprocket coaxial with (in front of, right of) the large brass 64T crank-drive gear at platen level; the chain wraps it and runs down to the crank. Center is the sprocket teeth-circle center (hub).
OPTIONAL second (lower) sprocket at the crank axle, on top of the crank arm; NOT the required pinion. Center = crank-axle hex-bolt (rotation axis).

Front end flange of the brass cam-drum = the cylinder-gear stack (20 identical 120T gears), seen ~end-on as a bright circular brass disc; center is the circular-face center. Identified as the cylinder (cam) drum because the visible toothed body is uniform-diameter and the CAD locates this drum's X from ch30 view 1 (this front view). The machine has a SINGLE cylinder-gear stack, so only one end is markable; no separate cylinder_gear_center_2 is visible (the second base drum is the cone gear, occluded).
